edits.anchor: - Split a demonstrative from its noun: 该台 is 台 with :mod 该 (never 电视台, and never one fused concept). Do not collapse a m
edits.text: - Lexicalized compounds and fixed anaphoric forms stay ONE concept: 电视台, 该台 (no separate 该 :mod), 数码制式, 定义户, 大部分. Do not split them into head + :mod. Other free multi-word NPs are still decomposed (head noun + :mod). Keep an overt head noun such as 名义 as the concept, with the name under it. Do not replace it with a named-entity type, and do not corefer it with the channel.

edits.anchor: Words with no PropBank frame (e.g. 启播, 自制, 告吹, 调往, 无意, 播出) get sense -01, never -00.
edits.text: Words with no PropBank frame (e.g. 启播, 回放) get sense -00; check PropBank first and use -01 or -02 only when a roleset exists (pick the roleset whose roles fit, e.g. 加入-02). The subject of 启播 is ARG0.

edits.anchor: - Concepts use the surface word as written: do not expand or normalize 获批 -> 批, 调往, 迁至, 购自 keep their complements).
edits.text: - Concepts use the base verb lemma. Strip the passive 获 (获批 -> 批-01) and the particles/suffixes 于/予/有 (设于, 设有 -> 设, location is ARG3; 售予 -> 售). Verbs like 调往, 迁至, 购自, 购入, 改为 keep their complements. Do not correct typos.

edits.anchor: are :mod on the event, never dropped and not :manner;
edits.text: are :mod on the event and never dropped; adverbs of how an event is carried out (轮流, 集中, 逐渐, 以标清/高清播放) are :manner;

edits.anchor: - Clock times are time-of-day entity nodes like h19m30 under :time of a date-entity, not quoted strings.
edits.text: - Clock times are time-of-day entity nodes with two-digit minutes (h19m30, h10m00) under :time of a date-entity, never bare values. A habitual broadcast time is rate-entity-91 with :ARG4 date-entity. 每天 is ARG2 temporal-quantity with :quant 1 and :unit 天. 介乎 X 和 Y is `range` with :op1/:op2.

edits.anchor: a date-entity is :overlap with the event it modifies and a past date gets DCT :before date.
edits.text: a date-entity of year/month granularity that locates an event is :contained of that event (use :overlap for day-level or same-time dates). Put the DCT relation only on the first date of a chain, not on every date. A completed modifier event (自制, 购自) is :before the main event it modifies (e.g. 播放). Temporal and modal relations hold only for event nodes, never for entity nodes.
- Modal: events under 可 (can/possible, e.g. 可接收, 可追溯) get :neutral-affirmative; 难以 is :partial-negative, not polarity -.

edits.anchor: and give nominals that are not events (申请, 计划) no same-event link.
edits.text: and an anaphoric re-mention of an earlier event (申请, 此限制) is a bare concept with no sense, aspect, temporal or modal relation, linked to its antecedent by :same-event. A plain noun 计划 as an argument of another event is also a bare concept.

edits.anchor: Taiwan, Hong Kong and mainland China (中国大陆) are `country-region`.
edits.text: Taiwan, mainland China (中国大陆) and large regions such as 加东/加西 are `country-region`; Hong Kong is `city`.

edits.anchor: Keep 《》 title marks as the first and last name tokens. Do not put generic suffixes such as 公司 in a company name.
edits.text: Do not put 《》 in name tokens. Include all tokens of a company name, including 公司. A city/place prefix that is part of a company or building name (香港亚洲电视, 列治文 mall) stays in the name tokens and is not a separate :place. A country such as 中国 in 中国中央电视台 is a separate country with :place.

- Special constructions: 联同 joins co-agents as `and` ARG0 (not :companion). 不同 takes one ARG0 `and` of the compared items. Role nouns (股东) are have-org-role-92 (ARG2 the organization); kinship is have-rel-role-92. 以…等语言 is 语言 :ARG2-of include-91 with ARG1 an `and` that includes 等. 继续 and stative 属/讲 relative clauses get :aspect state; 继续 takes only the embedded event as ARG1. 改为 target is ARG2 (change from X is :source). The result of 改组为 is :end-state. A channel that broadcasts is ARG0 of 播放. A channel belongs to its station by :part-of.
